basepath.description: Path to directory where comic subdirectories are created

baseurl.description: Base URL of the comics directory (for HTML/RSS output); must match --basepath

numstrips.description: Number of strips to retrieve; empty or unset means rely on ALL or CONTINUE mode or latest

parallel.description: Number of parallel connections; default 1 means sequential fetching

output.description: Output handler format: 'html', 'json', 'rss', or empty (plain files)

no_downscale.description: If true, disables downscaling for HTML/RSS output handlers

comics.description: List of comic module names or case-insensitive substrings to process by default

all.description: If true, retrieves all comic strips (equivalent to --all)

continue.description: If true, retrieves strips until an already-downloaded one is found (equivalent to --continue)

adult.description: If true, confirms user age for adult-content comics (equivalent to --adult)

allow_multiple.description: If true, permits concurrent dosage runs (equivalent to --allow-multiple)
